author: bd-spin/bd-spin-20260511T170116Z-854030
text:
Closing with the emit half landed. Per the do-beads "decompose mid-work" pattern, the residual scope was split out into two follow-ups:

- PKIX-9vnx.10 — OSCAL Risk parser for DeviationStore (closes the round-trip; lossless via the dn-der props the emitter already writes).
- PKIX-9vnx.11 — refactor DeviationScope from closed enum to open-ended props bag. Absorbs PKIX-8mzp's SubjectDnContains / PolicyOid as new kind strings rather than new enum variants. Depends on .10 for the round-trip oracle.

What's already done by this bead + the .3/.4 work:
- ✅ DeviatedFinding (per-run applied-deviation event) → OSCAL Risk inside Assessment Results [.3/.4].
- ✅ Deviation (policy entry) → OSCAL Risk via emit::risks_from_store [this bead].
- ✅ Scope axes expressible via OSCAL Subject + props [emit side; parser is .10].

Out-of-scope acceptance bullets passed to follow-ups:
- ❌ Round-trip persistence (emit + parse) → PKIX-9vnx.10.
- ❌ Scope axes without enum growth → PKIX-9vnx.11.

148 pkix-lint tests pass on --all-features. CHANGELOG entry merges .3/.4/.5 into the single 0.3.0 "Added" block.
